line=10 number=1 question="Where does the schema come from?" resolution="**(d)** a marker skeleton the document names in frontmatter, baked in per built-in type or a repo file under `templates/schema/`; templates become golden tests (§3)"
line=11 number=2 question="Marker spelling on the read side" resolution="(a) lenient read, canonical write, `marker.spelling` warning, fixed by the migration pass"
line=12 number=3 question="Is the finding message part of the contract?" resolution="(a) `Code` is the contract; `Detail` is a default a consumer may replace by code"
line=13 number=4 question="How is the corpus migrated?" resolution="(a) `docz update --regions`; **amended 2026-09-20 to (c)** `docz validate --fix`, since inference is permanent and the pass is defined by the findings `validate` reports"
line=14 number=5 question="Do ToC and index drift belong to validate?" resolution="(a) yes: `toc.stale` per document, `IndexDrift` per type; subsumes issue #97's `update --check`"
line=15 number=6 question="Which regions does the IMPL template mark?" resolution="(a) the full set: `phase` with nested `tasks` and `criteria`, plus `testing` and `references`; **amended 2026-09-19** to every section (§3)"
line=16 number=7 question="Hand-rolled walker or a CommonMark AST?" resolution="(a) hand-rolled, stdlib-only; goldmark behind the frozen contract only if CommonMark-fidelity bugs keep arriving"
line=17 number=8 question="Unknown kinds" resolution="(a) allowed; well-formedness only"
line=18 number=9 question="ToC and index splices on the region walker?" resolution="(a) internally yes: `Regions` reports the legacy ToC pair as `toc` and the README pair as `index`, and `toc.UpdateToC` and `index.Splice` locate their spans through it; externally nothing changes (DESIGN-0014 §2.5, §2.6)"
line=19 number=0 question="**Amendment 2026-09-19: every built-in is a structured type**" resolution="The catalogue grows from nine to forty-one kinds and every template section is a region (§2); each built-in's skeleton lists all of them (§3); `InsertRegions` derives its heading map from the marked template (§6); `docz validate` dispatches each document's type package on the resolved schema name with the type name as fallback, carried in `DocFindings.Schema` (§4). Unstructured markdown is the `api:` block's additional docs, not a type. DESIGN-0014 §2.9 and §2.12 hold the packages; IMPL-0018 Open Question 10 records the dispatch rule"
line=20 number=0 question="**Amendment 2026-09-20: documents without markers still parse**" resolution="A document with no `docz:` marker is inferred from its headings by `kinds.InferRegions`, in every type package's `Parse` (`Doc.Inferred`) and in `validate.Document` (`Options.Headings`, one `region.inferred` warning); a heading that is absent is still `region.missing`; markers, once present, are authoritative. Migration is `docz validate --fix`, which writes what inference found and re-validates (Open Question 4 as amended). The heuristic is permanent and pinned by the inference-equals-markers proof (§4, §6, DESIGN-0014 §2.9, §2.12)"
